name: Single-Leg Stand with Support

instructions.description: Stand beside a chair and shift weight onto one leg.
Lift the other foot slightly from the floor.
Keep the pelvis level and gaze steady.
Lower the foot and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record time maintained before using support or changing foot position.

variations.variationDescription: Single-Leg Stand with Support — Wider-Base Balance Version: Increase the base of support to reduce balance demand.

commentsNotes: Keep one or both hands near support.
